The '''''Des'maric Two''''' was a [[GAT-12h]] Skipray Blastboat operated by the [[Des'maric Pirates]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Along with ''[[Des'maric One]]'' and ''[[Des'maric Three]]'', the vessels were referred to as the [[Des'maric Blastboats]].
